description: Electron-builder cannot code sign on Windows ARM64 because its cached winCodeSign bundle lacks an ARM64 SignTool path, based on https://github.com/electron-userland/electron-builder/issues/9190.
prompt: I'm trying to sign an Electron Windows ARM64 build on a Surface Pro ARM runner. Packaging succeeds until signing, then electron-builder looks under an `arm64` signing-tools folder that isn't there. I can sign x64 builds from the same cert.
